user.title: Yeelight Curtain BLE
user.description: Choose a YLYDD-0053 curtain visible to a connectable Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome proxy. New or reset curtains will be offered a mounting-side step. Close Yeelight apps on the phone.

confirm.title: Connect {name}
confirm.description: Read the state to verify the connection. Close Yeelight on the phone first.

placement.title: Initial curtain setup
placement.description: The curtain is not configured yet. Choose the controller/power-side placement you would select in the Yeelight app. Submitting writes this setting over BLE and verifies it by reading it back. No Yeelight account or app is used for this step.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect or read the curtain. Close the phone app and check proxy reachability and free connection slots.
error.setup_failed: Could not confirm the mounting side. Release other BLE connections, check reachability and submit again. The device has not been added.

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not supported.
abort.no_devices_found: No YLYDD-0053 curtain is visible through a connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

init.title: Connection and custom GIFs
init.description: A persistent connection occupies a Bluetooth adapter or proxy slot. When disabled, disconnect after each command and its readback, and after each poll. Polling continues every 30 seconds; commands may take longer. Device notifications are only received while connected. Saving automatically reloads the integration. To add a GIF, enter its name and choose a file: 19×25 pixels, at most 48 frames and 128520 bytes. Saving only imports it into the library; use the separate GIF selector to play it. Reusing a name replaces its file. Custom GIF playback is experimental and has not been visually verified on hardware.

error.gif_name_and_file: Enter both a GIF name and a GIF file.
error.invalid_gif: Could not import the GIF. Choose the file again: use a valid 19×25 GIF with at most 48 frames and 128520 bytes, and a name of 1–64 characters.
